patterns: APPSC asks committee-chairman matches heavily: Finance and Staff = Rajendra Prasad, Union Constitution / Union Powers = Nehru, FR sub-committee = Kripalani; 'Steering Committee - Nehru' as the wrong pair.
Direct date items: Drafting Committee 29 Aug 1947, National Anthem 24 Jan 1950, adoption 26 Nov 1949 (Constitution Day).

Other PSCs repeat: M.N. Roy / Swaraj Party 1934 idea, Cabinet Mission 1946, indirect election by provincial assemblies, 15 women, Sachchidananda Sinha provisional President, Rajendra Prasad elected 11 Dec 1946.
Time-taken trap: APPSC key uses 2 years 11 months 18 days.
App adds much deeper material (Interim Govt portfolios, princely accession instruments, 2026 Vande Mataram law, sub-committee chairs) and many statement/match items; PYQs are single-fact one-liners.
